subject: POC: model selection & trial plan \u0014 next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:30:00 +0000
Subject: POC: model selection & trial plan  next steps

Hi Karen & Sam,

Thanks again for the call today  great to meet the Acme team. As promised, here's a short recap and proposed next steps for the 3-week POC so we can validate performance and multilingual behavior for your customer support routing + summarization use case.

Recap / success criteria (your input welcome):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for single-turn generate on a 512-token budget.
- Quality: intent classification + routing accuracy >= 92% on your evaluation set; summarization ROUGE-like qualitative checks (stakeholder sign-off).
- Robustness: handles English, Spanish, and Portuguese prompts with <5% error rate on code-switch samples.
- Cost: blended per-token inference cost target <= $0.015 per 1k tokens (ballpark; we'll optimize).

Proposed model selection for trial:
- Primary: meta/llama-2-70b-chat (quantized int8, Redwood-verified profile)  highest quality for routing + summarization.
- Fallback: meta/llama-2-13b-chat (32-bit or int8)  lower cost, lower latency option if we need to meet stricter SLOs.
- Multilingual consideration: we'll test Mistral-Instruct-Large as a third variant if we see Spanish/PT degradation  Mistral tends to be competitive on non-English.

Evaluation plan:
- Week 0 (kickoff): exchange eval dataset (you provide anonymized samples), confirm endpoints, and baseline run.
- Week 1: run bulk inference + automated metrics; review with your ML lead.
- Week 2: iteration (prompt tuning, temperature/sampling tweaks, batching/quantization adjustments).
- Week 3: final run, stakeholder demo, and success sign-off.

Ownership:
- Acme: Sam (technical owner)  provide eval dataset, prioritize success criteria, sign-off.
- Redwood: Marissa (eng sponsor) + Aditya (SE)  run experiments, share performance/cost dashboards, handle infra.

Next steps (ask):
1) Sam/Karen  confirm the success criteria above or flag edits.
2) Share the anonymized eval set (S3/Drive link) by EOD Thu, Jul 23 so we can start Week 0.
3) I'll send an internal POC brief and a one-page plan (attached) and a short trial agreement to sign.

Attachments: Acme_POCTestPlan_v1.pdf (POC brief), SOC2-questions.xlsx (you asked about logs/audit).

If that looks good I'll propose kickoff times for next week.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks  a couple of infra notes from the SE side: 

- For meta/llama-2-70b-chat (int8) we typically recommend a single 80GB GPU (A100 80GB or equivalent) for interactive p95 < 300ms with proper batching disabled; if you plan concurrent users we may need 2x 80GB with autoscaling policies.
- Llama-2-13b-chat (int8) runs comfortably on a single 48GB GPU (A10x or A5000-like) and will reduce cost materially.
- If you want to test a distilled or Mistral variant for multilingual, those run well on 48GB-class GPUs and often give tradeoffs: slightly lower quality in some English tasks but better cost/latency for ES/PT.
- We'll use Redwood's KV caching and prefix caching to accelerate repeated contexts; please include at least 100 long-format threads in the eval set so we can measure cache hit benefits.

I'll prepare a short GPU estimate table and share by EOD Thu so you can include it in procurement.

Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
